/bin/sh -lc "cat > lib/ai/model/tokencount_test.go <<'EOF'
package model

import (
    \"testing\"

    \"github.com/sashabaranov/go-openai\"
    \"github.com/stretchr/testify/require\"
    \"github.com/tiktoken-go/tokenizer/codec\"
)

func TestTokenCount(t *testing.T) {
    prompt := []openai.ChatCompletionMessage{
        {Role: openai.ChatMessageRoleSystem, Content: \"You are helpful.\"},
        {Role: openai.ChatMessageRoleUser, Content: \"Hello"'!"},
    }
    encoder := codec.NewCl100kBase()
    expectedPrompt := 0
    for _, message := range prompt {
        tokens, _, err := encoder.Encode(message.Content)
        require.NoError(t, err)
        expectedPrompt += perMessage + perRole + len(tokens)
    }
    promptCounter, err := NewPromptTokenCounter(prompt)
    require.NoError(t, err)
    require.Equal(t, expectedPrompt, promptCounter.TokenCount())

    completion := "Hello, world!"
    completionTokens, _, err := encoder.Encode(completion)
    require.NoError(t, err)
    completionCounter, err := NewSynchronousTokenCounter(completion)
    require.NoError(t, err)
    require.Equal(t, perRequest+len(completionTokens), completionCounter.TokenCount())

    total := NewTokenCount()
    total.AddPromptCounter(nil)
    total.AddCompletionCounter(nil)
    total.AddPromptCounter(promptCounter)
    total.AddPromptCounter(promptCounter)
    total.AddCompletionCounter(completionCounter)
    gotPrompt, gotCompletion := total.CountAll()
    require.Equal(t, 2*expectedPrompt, gotPrompt)
    require.Equal(t, perRequest+len(completionTokens), gotCompletion)
    require.Equal(t, 2*expectedPrompt, TokenCounters{promptCounter, promptCounter}.CountAll())
}

func TestAsynchronousTokenCounter(t *testing.T) {
    start := "<FINAL RESPONSE>Hello"
    tokens, _, err := codec.NewCl100kBase().Encode(start)
    require.NoError(t, err)
    counter, err := NewAsynchronousTokenCounter(start)
    require.NoError(t, err)
    require.NoError(t, counter.Add())

		responses = responses[1:]
	}))
	defer server.Close()

	cfg := openai.DefaultConfig("secret-test-token")
	cfg.BaseURL = server.URL + "/v1"
	client := NewClientFromConfig(cfg)

	chat := client.NewChat(nil, "Bob")

	ctx := context.Background()
	_, tokens, err := chat.Complete(ctx, "Hello", func(aa *model.AgentAction) {})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.NotNil(t, tokens)

	chat.Insert(openai.ChatMessageRoleUser, "Show me free disk space on localhost node.")

	t.Run("text completion", func(t *testing.T) {
		msg, tokens, err := chat.Complete(ctx, "Show me free disk space", func(aa *model.AgentAction) {})
		require.NoError(t, err)
		require.NotNil(t, tokens)

		require.IsType(t, &model.StreamingMessage{}, msg)
		streamingMessage := msg.(*model.StreamingMessage)
		require.Equal(t, "Which ", <-streamingMessage.Parts)
		require.Equal(t, "node do ", <-streamingMessage.Parts)
		require.Equal(t, "you want ", <-streamingMessage.Parts)
		require.Equal(t, "use?", <-streamingMessage.Parts)
		_, stillOpen := <-streamingMessage.Parts
		require.False(t, stillOpen)
		expectedCompletion, err := model.NewSynchronousTokenCounter("<FINAL RESPONSE>Which node do you want use?")
		require.NoError(t, err)
		_, completion := tokens.CountAll()
		require.Equal(t, expectedCompletion.TokenCount(), completion)
	})

	t.Run("command completion", func(t *testing.T) {
		msg, tokens, err := chat.Complete(ctx, "localhost", func(aa *model.AgentAction) {})
		require.NoError(t, err)
		require.NotNil(t, tokens)

		require.IsType(t, &model.CompletionCommand{}, msg)
		command := msg.(*model.CompletionCommand)
		require.Equal(t, "df -h", command.Command)
		require.Len(t, command.Nodes, 1)
		require.Equal(t, "localhost", command.Nodes[0])
	})
}

func TestChat_MultiStepTokenCount(t *testing.T) {
	first := `{"action":"Unknown tool","action_input":"input"}`
	second := `{"action":"Command Execution","action_input":{"command":"df -h","nodes":["localhost"]}}`
	responses := []string{first, second}
	var promptCounts []int
	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		body, err := io.ReadAll(r.Body)
		require.NoError(t, err)
		var request openai.ChatCompletionRequest
		require.NoError(t, json.Unmarshal(body, &request))
		counter, err := model.NewPromptTokenCounter(request.Messages)
		require.NoError(t, err)
		promptCounts = append(promptCounts, counter.TokenCount())

		require.NotEmpty(t, responses)
		content, err := json.Marshal(responses[0])
		require.NoError(t, err)
		responses = responses[1:]
		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "text/event-stream")
		_, err = fmt.Fprintf(w, "data: {\"choices\":[{\"delta\":{\"content\":%s}}]}\n\ndata: [DONE]\n\n", content)
		require.NoError(t, err)
	}))
	defer server.Close()

	cfg := openai.DefaultConfig("secret-test-token")
	cfg.BaseURL = server.URL + "/v1"
	chat := NewClientFromConfig(cfg).NewChat(nil, "Bob")
	chat.Insert(openai.ChatMessageRoleUser, "Run df")
	response, count, err := chat.Complete(context.Background(), "Run df", func(*model.AgentAction) {})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.IsType(t, &model.CompletionCommand{}, response)
	require.Len(t, promptCounts, 2)
	firstCompletion, err := model.NewSynchronousTokenCounter(first)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	secondCompletion, err := model.NewSynchronousTokenCounter(second)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	promptTotal, completionTotal := count.CountAll()
	require.Equal(t, promptCounts[0]+promptCounts[1], promptTotal)
	require.Equal(t, firstCompletion.TokenCount()+secondCompletion.TokenCount(), completionTotal)
}
